Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Single-Light Adjustable Pendant, 31"-72"H, Matte White
Colors: White
Materials: Metal
This sleek pendant light helps make lighting your home easy. The matte white-finished metal shade is the perfect soft neutral to blend with your living room or bedroom decor, and the adjustable height helps ensure you can have bright, clear light where you need it. 7.5"W x 7.5"D x 31"H; adjustable up to 72"H Metal shade in a matte finish Hardwired pendant with adjustable height means this simple, modern light works where you need it. 1 60-watt CEC Title 20 LED bulb included. Assemble in 15-30 minutes For indoor use only.
